title: Refactor ws-proxy ping/pong for keepalive only
description: Remove pong timeout logic - pings are for traffic generation to keep NAT/firewalls happy, not for detecting dead clients. Connection stays alive until explicitly closed.

title: WebSocket connections become stale after hours, require page reload (1006)
Inject reconnect-helper script into HTML responses
description: Modify proxy.js to intercept HTML responses from code-server and inject the reconnect-helper.js script before </body> tag.

title: Add TCP socket keepalive to WebSocket connections
description: Enable socket.setKeepAlive(true, 30000) on WebSocket connections to maintain NAT mappings at TCP layer.

title: Shells assigned to wrong workspaces on simultaneous reconnect from sleep
Auto-reload on WebSocket reconnection failure
description:
Improve UX when VSCode WebSocket reconnection fails. Instead of showing "Cannot reconnect. Please reload the window." dialog, automatically reload the page to restore the session.

Root cause: VSCode server session expires ~60 seconds after WebSocket drops. Browser tries to reconnect with old reconnectionToken but server has cleaned up.
design:
Two components:
1. Client-side JS script injected into pages - monitors for reconnection failure dialog
2. Proxy modification to inject script into HTML responses from code-server

title: Extend HTTP proxy timeouts to 5 minutes
description: Configure http-proxy with timeout: 300000 and proxyTimeout: 300000 to survive 5-minute network pauses.

title: Create reconnect-helper.js client script
description:
Create client-side JavaScript that:
- Uses MutationObserver to detect reconnection failure dialog
- Auto-reloads page after brief delay when detected
- Logs action to console for debugging
